proposition: Ibn Turka's nephew Afżal al-Dīn Muḥammad translated and commented on Shahrastānī's K. al-Milal wa-l-Niḥal for Shāhrukh (finished 13 Rajab 843/20 December 1439), seems in his introduction to allude to his uncle's tribulations, and was executed by Shāhrukh after Sulṭān-Muḥammad's failed rebellion of 850/1446.

mediation.who: Dawlatshāh, Tazkirat al-Shuʿarā; the nephew's own Tanqīḥ al-Adilla
mediation.note: the allusion to his uncle is MK's reading ('seems to')
